protocol_name: PenStrep Dilution Series for E. coli Chemotaxis Assay

paper.title: Agar loaded with chemicals as a drug-releasing mechanism for E. coli negative chemotaxis

gates.prompt: Remove prepared aqueous PenStrep dilutions for manual 1:1 mixing with molten 8% agar and casting into well plate.

off_deck: prepare 8% agar in LB media and keep at 80°C
mix aqueous PenStrep dilutions 1:1 (50% v/v) with molten agar in vial tubes
pipette 200 µL agar mixture into 12-well plate and allow partial solidification at an angle
add 200 µL diluted overnight E. coli culture into well
real-time microscopy imaging for motility tracking at 37°C
OD600 spatial measurement on Tecan Infinite M200 plate reader
open_clarifications: Paper states 'diluted to 15% and 25% by using LB media' before 1:1 mixing with agar. Volume fractions 0.15 and 0.25 reflect this intermediate dilution step.
Target cell density determination text is incomplete in source methods ('reduced to cell density to ** determined by **').
Stock PenStrep concentration is given as 10,000 U/mL (penicillin unit basis); commercial standard also includes 10,000 µg/mL streptomycin.
